thread:
Alex: Heads up — after migrating the sample source for /v1/generate to `route-proxy` during the quota rollout, the dashboard p99 jumped from ~210ms to ~720ms. p50/p95 look fine. Raw request logs don't show the same shift. Anyone else seeing this?
Marie: saw a similar spike in eu region this morning. p95 unchanged, just p99. could be tail sampling.
Sam: is the dashboard pulling "combined" rollups or route-level samples now?
Alex: Console link: https://console.redwood/c/latency?endpoint=%2Fv1%2Fgenerate — I think the migration flipped the sample source to `route-proxy` but the UI legend still says "dashboard" origin.
Jordan: quick hypothesis: if the sampling origin switched but weights changed slightly, p99 can jump if the new sample captures more heavy-tail requests. Did we preserve sample weights when migrating?
Claire: I checked the sampler config. We migrated seed/weights, but the route fallback policy added a 5% spill to legacy-route for cold-starts. Legacy-route has MUCH lower tail latency. If dashboard attributes by route-history instead of actual request path, that could explain mismatch.
Sam: can you paste the sampler snippet?
Claire: ``sampler:
  source: route-proxy
  weights:
    route-proxy: 0.95
    legacy-route: 0.05
  keyed_by: caller_tag
``
Marie: thanks. If dashboard rollup uses the tag `sample_origin` from the old ingestion path, it may still be merging using the legacy tag, while raw logs show real path.
telemetry-bot: Deployment detected: service=ingest-worker tag=route-sample-migration commit=ab12cd3 (2025-11-02T09:12:03Z)
Jordan: reproduce suggestion: force requests via route-proxy with header `X-Route-Hint: route-proxy` and compare p99 in raw logs vs dashboard for a 1k request batch. Curl: `for i in {1..1000}; do curl -s -H "X-Route-Hint: route-proxy" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" https://api.redwood/v1/generate >/dev/null; done`
Alex: I'll run that now on staging and post numbers. If we confirm, I think the console should show explicit "sample source" per-chart and expose a toggle between "origin-attributed" and "request-path-attributed" percentiles.
Sam: +1 for the toggle. Short-term, can we add a dashboard annotation explaining the migration window so on-call doesn't get paged for this?
Claire: I can add the annotation. Also opening a small fix: make ingestion attach actual `route_resolved` tag rather than relying on historical attribution — low risk.
Marie: timeline?
Claire: I'll send a PR today for the ingestion tag change, and annotate dashboards now. Alex, ping me the staging trace once you run the curl job.
Alex: posted staging numbers — raw logs p99 ~220ms, dashboard p99 ~700ms. Traces show most heavy-tail in requests with `caller_tag=mobile-ios` that got re-routed.
Jordan: that nails it. mobile-ios callers were preferentially routed to route-proxy for burst control. We need to ensure sample attribution follows the final resolved route.
Sam: ok, action items: (1) Claire PR to attach resolved route tag to ingestion (2) Marie add dashboard migration annotation (3) Alex share curl trace + sample ids (4) Product to consider UI toggle for attribution.
Alex: added to my TODOs. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
